title: Senior Scientist, Computational Biology
description: PhD in computational biology, genomics, bioinformatics or a related field with 0-2 years of experience. You will analyze RNA-seq and ATAC-seq data, build reproducible pipelines in Python and R, and deploy analyses on AWS. Focus areas include immunology and oncology target discovery.
human_note: Big-pharma ladder: Senior Scientist IS the fresh-PhD rung. PhD 0-2 stated explicitly. Commutable. Near-perfect.

title: Quantitative Scientist
description: Work as a member of the Quantitative Sciences team answering questions in cancer using a large real-world dataset. Develop analysis plans, write statistical analysis plans, and produce publication-ready methods and results. You hold a Master's degree with 4 years of industry experience or a PhD (or equivalent) in a quantitative discipline such as biostatistics, epidemiology, applied statistics or health economics. You have experience working in machine learning. EHR-derived real-world data, retrospective oncology cohort studies.
human_note: PhD-or-equivalent with no industry-years demand for the PhD branch. SAP authorship and oncology map one-to-one.

title: Research Scientist, Machine Learning
description: Train protein foundation models at scale. Deep experience with PyTorch, transformer architectures, large-scale distributed training, and representation learning. PhD or equivalent research experience with a strong publication record.
human_note: Lane 2 bullseye on paper; publications substitute for industry years. Discounted because ML research bar is high and his ML evidence is still thin.

title: Computational Biologist
description: PhD required. Analyze single-cell multi-omics data for immuno-oncology and autoimmune disease research in partnership with pharma and academic collaborators. Python, R, reproducible analysis, clear scientific communication.
human_note: Startup ladder, unmodified Scientist title = entry rung. Closest company-to-profile match on the target list.

title: Bioinformatics Scientist I
description: PhD, or MS with 2 years of experience. Build and maintain NGS pipelines, variant calling, and analysis of oncology sequencing data at scale.
human_note: Right rung and right domain, but Chicago-based. Would need remote flexibility.

title: Research Scientist, Biology Evaluations
description: Design benchmark and evaluation suites measuring frontier model capabilities in biology. PhD in the life sciences. Experience with red team exercises, model behavior analysis, and rigorous measurement design.
human_note: Content fit is excellent (DREAM benchmarking is a direct credential) but SF-based and extremely competitive.

title: Principal Scientist, Computational Biology
description: Design and deploy state-of-the-art computational pipelines and agentic workflows across industry partnerships. PhD with 8-10 years of relevant experience in single-cell multi-omics and immuno-oncology, plus demonstrated leadership of large initiatives.
human_note: Two rungs too senior. Worth logging as a hiring signal for outreach, not as an application.

title: Director, Computational Biology
description: Lead a department of computational scientists. PhD with 12+ years of experience and a track record of managing teams and portfolios.

title: Senior Sales Account Executive
description: Drive revenue growth across the territory. 5+ years of sales experience in genomics or life science tools. Quota-carrying role.
human_note: Genomics vocabulary but entirely the wrong function. Good adversarial case for keyword-only matching.

title: Bioinformatics Analyst
description: Support sequencing analysis for collaborating labs. BS or MS in a quantitative field with 1-3 years of experience. Familiarity with standard RNA-seq and variant pipelines.
human_note: Right place and domain but a BS/MS-level post: underleveled, underpaid, and he would read as a flight risk.
